subject: Unexpected throughput collapse in us-west-2 — emergency geo-remap & customer communications
messages:
From: Claire Zhou <czhou@acme-retail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@acme-retail.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Severe throughput drop in us-west-2 — impact to checkout (P1)

Soojin,

We started seeing a large spike in 5xx rates and request queueing hitting our checkout flows around 08:55 PDT. Token throughput for calls routed to us-west-2 has dropped ~75% and latency p95 has jumped from ~200ms to ~2.4s. Multiple customers are reporting timeouts. This started after a small deployment on your side (no code changes on our end).

Can your team urgently:
- confirm whether this is a regional service degradation on Redwood side
- outline immediate mitigation (cross-region remap, rate limiting, etc.)
- provide an initial ETR and whether this will affect our data residency commitments

We are preparing an incident page for our ops team and will share updates with our executive on-call. Please mark this P1.

I've attached a small sample of failing request logs from our system.

Thanks,
Claire
Head of Platform, Acme Retail

[attachment: us-west-2-error-sample-09-03.log]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <czhou@acme-retail.com>, ops@acme-retail.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe throughput drop in us-west-2 — immediate mitigation steps

Claire — thanks for the alert and the sample logs. We're treating this as a P1 and have stood up an SRE bridge.

Immediate actions we are executing now (ETA for cross-region steering: ~10-12 minutes):
- Activate geo-remap policy for your tenant: steer new traffic from us-west-2 -> us-east-1 and us-west-1 (read/write sticky routing will be preserved where possible).
- Enable temporary circuit-breaker thresholds to reduce amplification from retries.
- Disable the recent deployment bundle to rule out codepath regressions (we will rollback if we see improvement).

Rishi (SRE) is running the routing change and will post playbook commands. Vanessa, please prep a customer-facing statement (short ETR + what we changed). Marissa, flagging for executive sync if this persists >30m.

I'll post updates on the bridge.

Soojin
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

--

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: ops@acme-retail.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Severe throughput drop in us-west-2 — routing change in progress

Status update from SRE bridge: we see elevated kernel-sched stalls across the us-west-2 GPU pool and a corresponding queue length increase in the serving runtime. Initial investigation shows an abnormal spike in long-tail seq len requests after 08:50 — likely a workload pattern shift triggering inefficient batching kernels.

Actions taken (commands executed):
- Rolled back last deployment bundle id: deploy-20280520-b4 (rollback confirmed at 09:18 PDT).
- Issued routing change: set tenant override -> prefer us-east-1, fallback to us-west-1 for session affinity. Command: runbook geo-remap --tenant=AcmeRetail --primary=us-east-1 --secondary=us-west-1 --dry-run=false (see attached playbook).
- Enabled request-rate cap at edge: 40rps per IP (temporary).

Observed impact so far: 60% of new requests are being routed to us-east-1 and latency p95 for those calls is ~380ms; error rate dropped from 9.8% to 2.1% in the remapped window. Some older sticky sessions continue to target us-west-2 until clients reconnect.

Open risks/notes:
- Data residency: Cross-region routing will route inference requests (no model weights or customer data stored in new region beyond transient KV caches). If Acme has strict residency contracts, we need their explicit signoff before sustaining the change for >24 hours.
- Failback plan: We will only fail back to us-west-2 after reaching steady-state metrics for 30m and after deploying a kernel patch that reduces long-tail sequence inefficiency.

Attachment: geo-remap-playbook-v2.pdf (playbook + rollback steps)

Rishi
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

- We appreciate the rapid routing change. Can you confirm that PII or logs will not be transferred to the new region? Our legal team needs that assurance.
- How long do you expect the temporary cap to remain? Also please confirm the exact set of traffic (read/write inference calls) included.

If you need a written residency waiver to keep routing for >24h, we can expedite, but we need a short compliance blurb for our security team.

Claire

Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Incident summary & next steps — Acme Retail (us-west-2 degradation)

All — quick exec-level summary and actions:

What happened: us-west-2 experienced a serving runtime performance collapse around 08:55 PDT, caused by a workload-induced long-tail sequence amplification that pushed inefficient kernels and saturated the GPU queueing layer.

What we did (timeline):
- 09:03: customer reported issues; SRE bridge stood up.
- 09:12: routing override initiated; rollback of recent bundle executed.
- 09:18–09:30: ~60% of new traffic remapped to us-east-1; error rate reduced from 9.8% -> 2.1%.

Current state: system is stabilizing on remapped regions. p95 latency for remapped calls ~380ms. We are tracking metrics in INF-4821 and will only fail back when 30m of stable metrics are achieved and a kernel patch is validated.

Compliance note for Acme / Claire: transient inference request metadata (headers, request context) may traverse alternate regions for processing only; persistent storage or model weights are not replicated. I will provide a succinct compliance blurb for your security/legal within 15 minutes.

Compensation request: Vanessa, please coordinate with finance for a one-time usage credit up to 10% pending Marissa's signoff.

Next steps/actions assigned:
- Rishi: continue ramping remap, validate kernel patch (ETA 2–4h), monitor for 30m steady-state.
- Vanessa: finalize customer-facing incident update and credit proposal.
- Marissa: please confirm exec approval for credit if Acme revenue impact verified.
- Claire: please confirm whether you need a formal residency waiver for >24h routing.

I'll keep everyone posted on the bridge channel and post the postmortem slack thread once the incident is closed.

Thanks,
Soojin
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
